summary: Iteration 14 (client-side auto video compression) verified. Backend is untouched — iteration 13 video suite still 17/17 green (test_iteration13_videos.py). Frontend static contract all pass: (1) /app/frontend/src/lib/videoCompress.ts exists, exports compressVideoIfNeeded + COMPRESSION_THRESHOLD_BYTES, imports Video from 'react-native-compressor', imports SINGLE_UPLOAD_MAX_BYTES from '@/src/lib/cloudinary', threshold = 0.9 * cap, web is no-op, native uses expo-file-system for size + Video.compress({compressionMethod:'auto'}) with progress + AbortSignal. (2) /app/frontend/app/video/upload.tsx imports compressVideoIfNeeded (L26), phase union type includes 'compressing' (L72), awaits compressVideoIfNeeded(videoUri,{...}) at L141 BEFORE uploadVideoChunked at L158, progressLabel handles phase==='compressing' with 'Compressing video · N%' (L228-231), renders styles.compressedNote 'Compressed to X MB (−Y MB)' green note (L281,L481), size_bytes uses compressed finalBytes (L187). (3) package.json has "react-native-compressor": "1.11.0" (L48). (4) app.json expo.plugins contains 'react-native-compressor' (L86). (5) Metro bundler serves both / and /video/upload as HTTP 200 — new import chain doesn't break the bundle. No deprecated packages introduced; still expo-video / expo-image-picker / expo-camera / expo-audio-safe. No React Native red-screen. Actual on-device compression + video playback are out of scope for automated web testing (library requires AVAssetExportSession on iOS / MediaCodec on Android).
action_items: Nothing blocking for iteration 14. Pre-existing (not iter-14) noise carried over from iter-13 report: stale reels rows from long-purged test users still pollute /api/reels (fails test_iteration8_reels::test_reel_author_is_founder, ::test_video_url_reachable, test_iteration12_reset_pin::TestReelsRegression::test_10_reels_h264_forced) and orphan feed posts / leftover test_* users cause test_purge_verify::test_admin_users_only_founder + ::test_feed_no_orphan_posts to fail. Fix by hardening the startup auto-purge to also nuke reels/videos/posts authored by test_/TEST_/tec_/tpb_ users, not just the user documents.
critical_code_review_comments: videoCompress.ts: getSize on web returns 0 for non-blob URIs (e.g. remote https from picker on web); then the `originalBytes > 0 && originalBytes <= threshold` guard is skipped, but the Platform.OS==='web' early-return above still short-circuits to no-op, so this is safe.
upload.tsx: setPhase('idle') is set in `finally`, which resets phase even after successful router.replace — harmless because navigation has already happened.
compressed.bytes could be 0 on web (no-op branch) — code falls back to `videoBytes || null` for size_bytes so payload stays valid.

success_rate.backend: 100% on iteration-13 video suite (17/17). Non-video pre-existing failures unchanged from iter-13.
success_rate.frontend: 100% static contract (grep verified: videoCompress.ts exports, upload.tsx phase+await+progressLabel+compressedNote, package.json version, app.json plugin, Metro /video/upload = 200).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 14 adds a compression phase BEFORE the chunked Cloudinary upload in /app/frontend/app/video/upload.tsx. Nothing about the backend contract changed — /api/videos POST still accepts the same {title, description, video_url, thumbnail_url, duration, size_bytes, visibility, tags, category} body. The 5 pre-existing regression failures (reels stale rows + purge_verify orphans) are startup-purge scope bugs, NOT iter-14 regressions — main agent should fix by extending the auto-purge to also delete reels/posts/videos authored by test_/TEST_/tec_/tpb_ users on startup.
